# PDF positioning test fixtures

Each case has its own folder with the source PDF and the four expected A4 outputs:

```text
tests/fixtures/pdf-positioning/
└── <case>/
    ├── in.pdf       source label
    └── out-N.pdf    validated result with the label in quarter N
```

Quarters: 1 upper left, 2 upper right, 3 lower left, 4 lower right.

Cases:

- `a4` – portrait A4 with the label in its upper-left quarter.
- `a6` – A6 page, placed at its original scale in the chosen quadrant.
- `horizontal` – landscape A4 with the label in its upper-left quarter, turned 90°; it is rotated upright into the portrait quadrant. The `out-N.pdf` files were generated by the code and need manual validation.

The test generates every position from `in.pdf`, renders generated and reference PDFs, and compares first-page pixels, so it checks the visible print result rather than file bytes.

Run with `npm test`. CI uploads a `pdf-positioning-diffs` artifact (expected, actual, pink diff) when it fails.
